summary: This Form 8-K reports an unregistered sale of 379,963 common shares for ~$9.4 million at $24.78 per share under Rule 506(b)/Section 4(a)(2), representing an ordinary capital raise by a closed-end credit fund. Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclose routine portfolio metrics as of April 30, 2026 (56 portfolio companies, $1.86B commitments, 96% senior secured). No special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spinoff, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change.
